source: Formulas.calcGeneralTraitBonus(attacker, target, traitType, ignoreResistance), calcWeaponTraitBonus, calcAttackTraitBonus
note: kind 'general': every TraitType (name, ordinal, type 0 none / 1 weapon / 2 weakness / 3 resistance) x ignoreResistance. NONE returns 1, invulnerable targets 0, weakness traits need an attack AND a defence trait on the pair, resistance traits clamp(attackTrait - defenceTrait + 1, 0.05, 2). kind 'weapon': calcWeaponTraitBonus (1 - (defence trait of the attacker's weapon type - 1)); kind 'attack': calcAttackTraitBonus. No draws. Trait tables are in the creatures file.
